title: Case pattern
tagline: Re-run a chain of features for every case of a Case template -- each case with its own selections and values -- and name the new bodies by case.

slides.title: What it does
slides.problem: 'Apply to each' for the feature tree. Onshape's Pattern moves copies by a transform; Evan Reese's Query Pattern rebinds one seed. Case pattern rebinds up to 8 query variables and 4 values per case and re-runs the listed features for each case.
useWhen: A detail repeats on places that differ in shape
Each place needs its own dimensions
The chain edits existing geometry (fillets, move face) as well as making new
slides.caption: T1: the boss chain on three blocks, each at its own height and radius.

points.head: Inside the list
points.body: Geometry one listed feature made, used by another, must come through a Query variable 'created by' that feature.

points.head: Why
points.body: Each case runs in a pattern frame that remaps those references onto the case's copies; clicks stay on case 1.

points.head: Outside the list
points.body: References to existing geometry are fine: they are rebound through the template's names.

slides.title: The dialog
params: The chain built on the template's names.
Which new bodies to keep per case (sketches off by default).
Between name and case (default _): Boss_A -> Boss_B.

slides.title: Example: bosses on three blocks (T1)
slides.head: Chain: Boss (extrude #top by #bossH), rim fillet 2 mm, #bossEdges = edges created by Boss, fillet #bossEdges at #edgeR
slides.body: Case A: 15 mm, R3 (the template). Case B: 25 mm, R3. Case C (pentagon): 8 mm, R2. New bodies are named Boss_<case>. (In the studio case B is currently named 'Foobar!'.)

keys: The bodies each case created (filtered by Keep), named <name>_<case>.
messages: Not built: B: input 1 (#top) selects nothing; C: feature 2 failed (...)
The other cases are still built.
N bodies kept Onshape's default name
Edit the Case pattern once to refresh case 1's names.

items.head: Sketches
items.body: Re-solved per case, but references to input geometry stay on case 1. Build sketches on geometry derived from the inputs.

items.head: Order matters
items.body: Cases run in order and see earlier results; a failed case cannot undo edits to existing geometry.

items.head: Cost
items.body: (cases + 1) x the chain on every rebuild.

items.head: Verified
items.body: Fillet and Move face on existing geometry, new extrudes, native query variables (T1-T5).
